title: $C^0$-inextendibility of a class of warped-product black hole spacetimes
summary: We adapt Sbierski's proof of $C^0$-inextendibility of the maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime to a broad class of warped-product black hole spacetimes with a static exterior region. These spacetimes are globally hyperbolic, have a codimension-two Riemannian fibre and a radial coordinate $(r)$, which serves as the warping function of the fibre. They admit a spacetime singularity as $r \to 0$, characterised by the divergence of the Kretschmann scalar.
